sources.title: Survey of Hallucination in Natural Language Generation
sources.abstract: Hallucination describes generated content that is unsupported by the provided source or real-world knowledge. Verification and grounding are common strategies for reducing unsupported generation.

sources.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP
sources.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation combines parametric language models with retrieved external evidence. Grounding generation in retrieved documents can improve factuality and knowledge-intensive task performance.

sources.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
sources.abstract: ReAct interleaves reasoning traces with actions so a language model can gather information and adapt its plan. The approach links deliberate reasoning with external tool use.

sources.title: Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks
sources.abstract: Sentence-BERT produces semantically meaningful sentence embeddings that can be compared efficiently. These embeddings support semantic search and similarity-based filtering.

sources.title: Blackboard Architecture for Control
sources.abstract: A blackboard architecture coordinates heterogeneous knowledge sources through a shared data structure. Components contribute opportunistically without requiring direct peer-to-peer invocation.
